links.outcome: Accuracy change after prior-chat distractors across 14 LLMs on MedQA and EHRNoteQA
links.effect: MedQA multiple-choice: significant accuracy drops in 13 of 14 models, averaging 15.0 percentage points. Smaller effects for conversational distractors and free-response. EHR task: average decreases under 2 points, significant in a minority of models.
links.quote: In this setting, insertion of this user message led to significant accuracy decreases in 13 of 14 models, with drops averaging 15·0 percentage points across models.

unlisted_practices: Testing LLM susceptibility to prior-chat (multi-turn) distractors, including messages about a different patient

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM robustness to conversational context and prior-chat distractors across benchmark and EHR QA datasets without evaluating an organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
